_readme: Edit this file, then run `node build.js`. Anything written inside [[double brackets]] is a placeholder: it is highlighted on the page, listed by the build, and blocks LocalBusiness schema until replaced. Leave a list empty ([]) to hide it.

business.name: Deep Cleaning by Renata
business.coverage: [[Areas covered, e.g. towns or postcode districts]]
business.companyDetails: [[Trading details, e.g. sole trader / company number and registered address]]

founder.bio: [[One or two sentences from Renata about herself and how she works]]

form._help: POST endpoint that accepts form data and returns JSON (e.g. Formspree, Basin, Getform, or your own). Leave as a placeholder and the form will tell visitors to call or email instead.
form.processor: [[Name of the form service that receives enquiries]]

eco._help: The business's main selling point. UK Green Claims Code: keep claims specific and provable, never 'chemical-free' or '100% natural'.
eco.products: [[Which products or brands Renata uses, and any eco certifications, e.g. EU Ecolabel]]
eco.strongerProducts: [[Whether a stronger product is ever needed, e.g. heavy limescale, and how customers are told first]]

privacy.processorDetails: [[Where the form provider stores data, with a link to its privacy policy]]
privacy.retention: [[How long enquiries are kept, e.g. deleted after 12 months if no booking follows]]

services.name: End-of-tenancy clean
services.suitedTo: Tenants moving out, landlords and letting agents between tenancies.
services.summary: A thorough clean of the property before checkout or the next tenancy. If you have the inventory or check-in report, mention it so the quote reflects what will be checked.

services.name: After-builders clean
services.suitedTo: Homeowners after a renovation, extension or refurbishment, and builders handing a property back.
services.summary: Cleaning the fine dust and residue left once building work has finished. Tell us what work was done and whether any trades are still on site.

services.name: One-off deep clean
services.suitedTo: Homes that need a thorough reset — before a sale, after moving in, or simply overdue.
services.summary: A single, top-to-bottom clean for a home that needs more than a routine tidy. This is a one-off job, not a regular cleaning schedule.

extrasNote: Oven interiors, carpet cleaning and rubbish removal are not assumed to be included. Mention them in your enquiry and we’ll confirm whether they can be added.

faqs.a: [[Confirm the towns or postcode districts covered, and whether travel outside them is possible]]

faqs.q: Do I need to be there during the clean?
faqs.a: [[Confirm how access works, e.g. meeting on site, key safe, or collecting keys from the agent]]

faqs.q: How should I prepare the property?
faqs.a: [[Confirm preparation, e.g. whether the property should be empty and electricity and hot water left on]]

faqs.q: What cleaning products do you use?
faqs.a: Eco-friendly products, with strong chemicals kept to a minimum. If anyone in the home has allergies or sensitivities, mention it when you enquire. [[Name the products or brands used, and when anything stronger is needed]]

It depends on the type of clean and the property, so the checklist is agreed with your quote before anything is booked. Oven interiors, carpets and rubbish removal are only included if we’ve confirmed them.

faqs.q: Will an end-of-tenancy clean get my deposit back?
faqs.a: No cleaner can promise that — deposit decisions are made by your landlord or letting agent and cover more than cleanliness. What we can do is clean to the checklist we agree with you.
Send the quote form or give us a call. Once you’re happy with the quote and scope, we’ll arrange a date. [[Confirm payment terms, e.g. deposit on booking or payment on completion]]
